one_line: Pala emperor who restored royal power over Gauda and Bengal in the early 11th century.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a solid, warrior-king build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Bengali complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, straight nose, neatly kept moustache with a trimmed short beard along the jawline, default expression calm and composed with a hint of determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a low knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth and tidy, topped with a modest dark-red cloth turban (paghri) wrapped close to the skull with a narrow gold band and a small central lotus-shaped gold brooch.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate royal outfit: an off-white fine cotton angarkha-style tunic reaching mid-thigh, overlapping right panel tied with hidden ties, bordered with a narrow maroon and gold woven edge; over it a rich deep-green silk uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the torso and back, embroidered with small repeating gold lotus motifs; lower body in a deep-maroon dhoti of heavy cotton/silk blend, pleated neatly and wrapped to the ankles with a subtle gold stripe along the hem; a broad gold waist-belt (katisutra) with simple stamped patterns cinches the dhoti and tunic; feet in brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery limited to a single medium-width gold necklace with a round pendant, a pair of small gold stud earrings, and two plain gold bangles on the right wrist, evoking royal dignity without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved steel sword with a simple iron cross-guard and a dark-wood hilt wrapped in brown leather, sheathed in a plain dark-brown scabbard with minimal brass fittings, carried at his left hip suspended from a dark-brown leather belt worn over the waist-belt.

ref_desc: Mahipala I is a tall, broad-shouldered Bengali king with medium-brown skin, neat moustache and short beard, black hair in a low knot under a dark-red cloth turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, deep-green embroidered shawl, maroon dhoti, gold belt and jewellery, brown sandals, and a curved steel sword in a dark-brown scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Mahipala I, the Pala emperor: a tall, broad-shouldered Bengali man in his late 30s or early 40s with medium-brown skin, an oval face, strong jaw, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, a neat black moustache and short beard along the jawline, and thick black hair pulled into a low knot. He wears a close-wrapped dark-red cloth turban with a narrow gold band and a small central lotus-shaped gold brooch. His outfit is an off-white fine cotton angarkha-style tunic reaching mid-thigh, overlapping to the right with a narrow maroon-and-gold woven border, over which a rich deep-green silk uttariya (shawl) drapes from his left shoulder across his chest and back, embroidered with tiny repeating gold lotus motifs. He wears a deep-maroon dhoti wrapped to his ankles with careful pleats and a subtle gold stripe along the hem, held by a broad gold waist-belt with simple stamped designs and an additional dark-brown leather sword belt over it. His jewellery is restrained: a medium-width gold necklace with a round pendant, small gold stud earrings, and two plain gold bangles on his right wrist. On his feet are brown leather sandals with toe loops. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved steel sword with a simple iron cross-guard and a dark-wood hilt wrapped in brown leather, in a plain dark-brown scabbard with minimal brass fittings. Use a palette dominated by deep green, maroon, off-white, gold, and dark brown, and present him in neutral, front, side, and three-quarter poses suitable for consistent redrawing, emphasizing his composed but determined expression and dignified royal bearing.
